text:
Emma: Heads up — Ryan (contractor) confirmed last day is Fri 2026-04-05. Need to coordinate: final invoice/payment, laptop return, access deprovision timing (repos, service tokens), and clarify COBRA/benefits eligibility. Looping in @Jordan (manager), @IT, @Security, @Payroll, @Benefits.

Ryan: Confirmed — last day is Fri Apr 5. Will finish the handoff doc and send my final invoice on 2026-04-10. I have the company laptop and VPN + a few service tokens.

Jordan: Thanks. Manager request: keep repo access read-only and calendar viewable through Mon Apr 12 for a 1-week shadow handoff. Approving delayed deprovision for collaborator access only.

IT: We can provide a prepaid shipping label or arrange an onsite drop-off. Standard policy is to deactivate accounts 24h after last day for contractors; we can delay repo token revocation until Apr 12 with manager approval. Need confirmation of pickup vs drop-off from Ryan.

Security: We need an inventory of any infra credentials Ryan still holds (AWS, DockerHub, service tokens, CI secrets). We'll rotate any org-level keys. Default action: revoke SSO 48h after last day unless exception. @Ryan can you list the services?

Ryan: I have AWS keys for redwood-project-build, DockerHub creds, and a long-lived token for the internal eval-runner service. I'll rotate anything I control and put temporary replacements where needed. I can stop using company accounts after Apr 12 if access kept.

Emma: Quick clarifications for Payroll/Benefits: contractor status = not eligible for COBRA. @Payroll please confirm final invoice processing cadence and whether we can prioritize this one. @Benefits to confirm COBRA ineligibility and any expense reimbursements deadlines.

Payroll: Final invoice processed Net30 from receipt; we can flag AP to prioritize if required — please route invoice to ap@redwood.com and cc your manager. For contractors we do not do COBRA admin.

Benefits: Confirming contractors are not enrolled in company medical plans, so COBRA does not apply. Any outstanding expense reimbursement requests should be submitted by EOD Fri Apr 5 to guarantee inclusion in the current cycle.

Security: Noted. We'll schedule infra token rotation on Mon Apr 6 at 10:00am PT unless Jordan asks to delay. Please DM the repo list to security + IT by Thu — we need explicit read-only exceptions.

Jordan: I'll DM the repo list by Thu morning. Approve read-only through Apr 12 for the listed repos.

IT: Shipping label will be posted in DM tomorrow. If Ryan drops at office, we can do same-day intake and mark asset returned. Laptop wipe will be scheduled after asset receipt and after confirmation of any retained artifacts needed for handoff.

Ryan: I'll ship laptop Mon Apr 8 and post tracking in this thread. Handoff doc link (draft): https://redwood.internal/docs/handoffs/ryan-contract-handoff.md — will update before EOD Thu.

Emma: Scheduling exit interview Tue Apr 9 11:00am PT (30m) with People Ops. Ryan — are you opting in? We'll also send the standard offboarding survey after the interview.

Ryan: Opting in for the exit interview. Appreciate the coordination 🙏

deploy-bot: Reminder — please ensure service accounts mentioned are rotated. Automated check will run on 2026-04-06 10:00:00 PT and will report any unchanged tokens.

Emma: Thanks everyone — summary: Payroll/AP to prioritize invoice, Benefits confirmed no COBRA, IT shipping label + laptop return process, Security to rotate org tokens Apr 6 (unless delayed), manager to DM repo list by Thu, exit interview Tue Apr 9. I'll update the offboard checklist and ping again on Thu for any outstanding items.
